scripts.dev:app: POSTGRES_HOST=localhost RABBITMQ_HOST=localhost NODE_ENV=development turbo run local
scripts.infra:up: ENV_FILE=.env.local docker compose --env-file .env.local --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d ci-os-hub-queue ci-hub-db
scripts.start:docker: ENV_FILE=.env.local docker compose --env-file .env.local --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.local.yml up --build
scripts.init:host: pnpm exec tsx scripts/init-traefik.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/init-docker-config.ts
scripts.start:prod: pnpm run init:host && ENV_FILE=.env.prod docker compose --env-file .env.prod --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build
scripts.start:staging: pnpm run init:host && ENV_FILE=.env.staging docker compose --env-file .env.staging --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build
scripts.start:dev: pnpm run init:host && ENV_FILE=.env.dev docker compose --env-file .env.dev --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build
scripts.start:dev:detached: pnpm run init:host && ENV_FILE=.env.dev docker compose --env-file .env.dev --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
scripts.check:all: pnpm run lint && turbo run tsc && turbo run build && turbo run test
scripts.fresh: pnpm run cleanup && pnpm start dev
scripts.fresh:local: pnpm run cleanup && pnpm start local
